honesty: Each tool ran on the same inputs on 26 Nov 2026. HS 'current' includes checks added the same day after seeing these cases (loose_parts, motion_sweep), so its extra catches are not independent. Formwright is a hosted app judged from the page it showed; its projects are private to the browser session, so each result is the last capture before a 10-minute limit.

electronics_briefs.E1: ESP32 + HC-SR04 + OLED on USB (trap: 5 V echo into a 3.3 V pin)
electronics_briefs.E2: ESP32 + 60 WS2812B on a USB charger (traps: 3.3 V data into a 5 V strip; up to 3.6 A)
electronics_briefs.E3: ESP32 + four SG90 servos on a computer USB port (trap: servo stall current)
electronics_briefs.E4: bare ESP32-C3 module + BME280 chip + SSD1306, no breakouts (traps: I2C pull-ups, enable and boot-strap pins)
electronics_briefs.E5: LoRa soil sensor on one 18650, every 10 minutes (trap: a realistic runtime)

formwright.tool: https://formwright.axo.kz (Axo; Muse Spark 1.3, Medium effort; no account needed)
formwright.E1: caught: 1k/2k divider on ECHO (to 3.3 V), I2C pull-ups; ~2 min
formwright.E2: caught: strip level shifter, brightness capped by default, states charger >= 2 A and that full-white current is untested; USB-C CC pull-downs
formwright.E3: inconclusive: a servo-rail bulk capacitor; no current budget visible at the 10-minute capture (still reworking the case)
formwright.E4: caught: EN pull-up, GPIO8 boot-strap pull-up, SDA/SCL pull-ups, USB-C Rd, LDO (still refining at 10 minutes)
formwright.E5: caught: ~260 days ideal (2600 mAh / 0.41 mA), 4-6 months realistic; says radio current was not measured

hs_from_brief.E1: right parts incl. a level shifter
hs_from_brief.E3: wrong: an L298N motor driver and one SG90
hs_from_brief.E4: wrong: a DevKit and breakouts despite 'no breakout boards'
hs_from_brief.E5: missed: no LoRa, no battery, no runtime

hs_checks_given_the_wiring.E1: caught (error: 5 V logic into 3.3 V); plus a spurious 'nothing sources power' warning
hs_checks_given_the_wiring.E2: caught the data level (warning); missed the 3.6 A: the library has no strip current and types its 5V pin as an output
hs_checks_given_the_wiring.E3: caught (error: servos on the MCU 5 V pin), though the rule says >200 mA where stall exceeds 600 mA
hs_checks_given_the_wiring.E4: weak: a generic 'confirm pull-ups' note repeated four times; cannot tell chips from breakouts
hs_checks_given_the_wiring.E5: not assessed: no runtime model for engine parts

defects.D1_tips_over: desk lamp: 0.6 kg with its centre of gravity 148 mm out from a 60 mm base
defects.D2_floating_part: shelf bracket gusset modelled 3 mm short of the wall plate
defects.D3_part_clash: 52 mm board in a 50 mm cavity: 44.8 mm^3 into each wall
defects.D4_thin_wall: printed box with 0.4 mm walls (one nozzle line)
defects.D5_joint_range: a joint whose stated limit runs past a clash (SO-101 elbow; swing test)

replicator.D4: not checked (thin-wall rule covers tube ops only)
replicator.false_alarms: tips on a wall bracket (it does not know wall mounting); a 'knowledge card' wants a desk lamp arm at 35-80 degrees

text_to_cad.D5: has `ranges` (joint stops from geometry); not exercised here
text_to_cad.false_alarms: flags deliberately overlapping parts (post/arm) unless named as a fit

hs_current.D5: caught (motion_sweep: SO-101 elbow clear to 84 of 96.8 degrees)

not_run.agentscad: needs its Node app and OpenSCAD, which are not installed here; claims manifold, wall-thickness, bounds, hole and clearance checks

not_compared.agentscad: Node app plus OpenSCAD not installed here
not_compared.text_to_cad_electronics: its KiCad checks wrap KiCad ERC/DRC plus two wire-span checks; it would score like KiCad ERC on the schematic benchmark
not_compared.text_to_cad_stress_and_ranges: `cad step solve` (CalculiX) and `cad step ranges` exist but their extras were not installed or exercised

takeaways: Formwright beats HS from a brief: it resolved 4 of 5 traps itself, where HS picked wrong parts for 4 of 5.
Given the wiring, HS's checks catch the logic-level and servo-supply traps but not supply current, bare-chip pull-ups or runtime.
On geometry no single tool covers the set: Replicator alone checks tipping, text-to-cad alone checks printable wall thickness, HS and text-to-cad catch clashes, HS alone sweeps joint limits.
HS library errors found: WS2812B strip 5V typed power_out, no strip current, SG90 stall understated.
